# Baton

> MCP server, CLI, and floating HUD so coding agents can run, hot-reload, boot simulators, and screenshot Flutter, Next.js, Vite, and React Native apps from any terminal.

Baton replaces the IDE Run & Debug toolbar with a loopback daemon. People use `baton` and `baton hud`. Agents use `baton-mcp` (Model Context Protocol) or the same CLI.

## Install

**Clone and build** (works today):
```
git clone https://github.com/kanumuri9593/Baton.git && cd Baton
npm install && npm run build
npm link
```

**npm** (404 until v0.2.1 is published): `npm install -g baton-run`

- MCP command: `baton-mcp` (after npm link or install)
- HUD: `baton hud` — native panel on macOS, browser window elsewhere. No App Store app.
- Node.js 24+, MIT license, macOS / Linux / Windows
- Repo: https://github.com/kanumuri9593/Baton

**Troubleshooting:** If `baton` fails with ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING, uninstall old baton-run@0.2.0 and reinstall from a built clone.
